name: partner_get_context
description: Read current scoped partner/person context and verified knowledge. Other people's conversations are excluded in a conversation run.

name: partner_list_work
description: Read existing tasks in this run's scope. Do not duplicate them.

name: partner_search_experience
description: Search owner-reviewed lessons. Private lessons from other conversations are excluded.

name: partner_propose_draft
description: Queue a proposed message for the current person. Does not approve or send. Use this tool for addressed messages; final prose is only an internal note.

name: partner_propose_fact
description: Propose a sourced fact about the current person for review. This does not confirm the fact.

name: partner_propose_task
description: Propose a future task with purpose and evidence. Follow-ups require a conversation and source of agreement. The owner approves before scheduling.

name: partner_propose_lesson
description: Store a candidate lesson with evidence and applicability. It cannot become active without owner review.

name: partner_propose_capability
description: Record a missing capability and optional SKILL.md proposal. Does not install code, grant rights or change active skills.
